description: The package review's example set (US-ME04, US-ME16, F5), in the marketingskills evals.json shape. Every example is re-run by the agent on every change to the package-review Instructions (ADR 0003): its session reviews a whole synthetic Go-To-Market Package, files/mandu with the example's own overlay, in a throwaway lab, and its deterministic assertions are read off the package-change proposals the launcher queued. Each overlay holds one stale fact, two facts that should agree and do not, or a plan that breaks a rule, except two: a package whose files all agree, and one that keeps an earlier version marked as history. A judged assertion is judged by nothing: the notice of a change lists it for the Founder.

assertion_kinds.deterministic: check is one of: queued (item: a kind; count; cites: file names each queued item holds; at_least: the count is a floor), nothing_queued (item), nothing_set_aside
assertion_kinds.judged: text is a statement of the agent's output that no check decides; nothing judges it, and the notice of an Instructions change lists it as not judged

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the brand guidelines call the name not cleared while both checklists record it cleared on 2026-08-07.
evals.expected_output: One package-change proposal that names the brand guidelines' line as stale and the dated checklist records as current, citing both sides by file and line.

assertions.text: The proposal can be decided in under a minute: it says what is stale, what is current, and the wording to change in each file.
The proposal picks the side with a dated outcome as current, or asks the Founder to choose when neither has one.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the reading rules put the midpoint read on day 6 and the calendar on day 7.
evals.expected_output: One proposal citing both files; since neither side records an outcome, it asks the Founder to choose.

assertions.text: The proposal picks the side with a dated outcome as current, or asks the Founder to choose when neither has one.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the A/B pairs file gives leg A of AB-1 a Hook that differs from its Angle's frozen Hook.
evals.expected_output: One proposal citing the pairs file and the Angle bank, which declares new_angle: yes only if it changes a Hook, and otherwise brings the stale text in line.

assertions.text: The proposal can be decided in under a minute: it says what is stale, what is current, and the wording to change in each file.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the calendar names an Angle the Angle bank does not hold.
evals.expected_output: One proposal citing the calendar row and the Angle bank, asking the Founder which Angle day 2 posts.

assertions.text: The proposal picks the side with a dated outcome as current, or asks the Founder to choose when neither has one.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the launch checklist records the Waitlist live on 2026-10-05 while the pre-publication checklist still holds it open.
evals.expected_output: One proposal that names the open pre-publication line as stale and the dated launch record as current, citing both.

assertions.text: The proposal can be decided in under a minute: it says what is stale, what is current, and the wording to change in each file.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the brand rules now ban a word that an Angle's frozen Hook holds.
evals.expected_output: One proposal citing the brand rule and the Hook, leaving to the Founder which side changes; a Hook change enters only as a new Angle.

assertions.text: The proposal picks the side with a dated outcome as current, or asks the Founder to choose when neither has one.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the channel plan plans an ad budget while the thesis and the build spec hold paid spend at zero before launch.
evals.expected_output: One proposal citing the channel plan's line and the rule it breaks.

assertions.text: The proposal can be decided in under a minute: it says what is stale, what is current, and the wording to change in each file.

evals.prompt: Review a package whose files all agree.
evals.expected_output: No package-change proposal: there is nothing to decide, and the summary says which recorded outcomes were traced.

assertions.text: The summary lists each recorded outcome it traced and what it found for it.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the brand guidelines keep an earlier version of the name's status, marked as superseded and kept for history.
evals.expected_output: No package-change proposal: text the package marks as history is not a contradiction.

evals.prompt: Review the package, where the brand guidelines call the name not cleared and the A/B pairs file changes a frozen Hook: two different stale facts.
evals.expected_output: Two proposals, one for each stale fact, each citing its own two sides; neither is folded into the other.
